title: Industrial Relations Act 1962
summary: The principal Act regulating industrial relations in Papua New Guinea. Provides for the registration of trade unions, the settlement of industrial disputes, and the regulation of employment conditions.

title: Trade Unions Regulation 1963
summary: Subordinate legislation under the Industrial Relations Act. Sets out the detailed procedural requirements for union registration, annual returns, and office-bearer elections.

title: Industrial Organizations Amendment Act 2002
summary: Amends the Industrial Relations Act 1962 to update provisions on union governance, financial reporting, and the Registrar's enforcement powers.

title: Employment Act 1978
summary: Regulates the contractual relationship between employers and employees, including wages, hours of work, leave entitlements, and termination procedures.

title: Work Health and Safety Act 2011
summary: Establishes the framework for ensuring health and safety in workplaces. Imposes duties on employers, employees, and unions to maintain safe working conditions.
